newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-ROCCA WITHDRAWS FROM U.S. OPEN, TWAY TAKES HIS PLACE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ROCCA WITHDRAWS FROM U.S. OPEN, TWAY TAKES HIS PLACE.

text.p: European Ryder Cup star Costantino Rocca of Italy withdrew from the U.S. Open championship on Tuesday morning because of a muscle injury, officials said.
The 40-year-old Rocca has struggled this season, missing six cuts, but played well in the year's first major championship, tying for fifth at the Masters.
Taking the Italian's place in the 156-man field will be Bob Tway.

Tway, the 1986 PGA champion, had narrowly missed qualifying for the field. He was involved in a nine-way playoff for seven spots in his qualifying section and was eliminated with a bogey on the fifth extra hole.
